label: übernehmen

edition.check: Level 5: input barcode 731456031125 is valid UPC-A (tl-gtin) – MET. It matches exactly this edition in ≥2 independent sources: MusicBrainz 41b0a392 (barcode 0731456031125, Polystar 560 311-2, DE 2000, CD+CD), Discogs 1949898 (barcode scanned, 560 311-2) and musik-sammler.de (EAN 731456031125, Polystar 560 311-2, step 17) – MET. The back-cover reading also shows the printed barcode. Format (2×CD) and artist (Various) match – MET. Other editions with the same barcode are Discogs 23145932 (UK-made) and 26676554 (Europe). Both are pressing variants with the same cat. no., and 23145932 shows an identical tracklist. The club edition (610930) has a different barcode and the MC has a different format – MET, no competing tracklist under this barcode. All conditions met.
edition.summary: The barcode leads unambiguously to the same 2×CD Polystar 560 311-2 in MusicBrainz, Discogs and musik-sammler.de, and only pressing variants share the barcode.

tracklist.check: Level 5: ≥2 independent sources of the same edition must agree on count, order and titles. MusicBrainz shows 20+20 tracks. Discogs 1949898 and 23145932 show the same order and titles, with only spelling and version-suffix variants (e.g. 'Album Version' at 1-10, Strassen/Straßen). The back cover (vision) confirms order and titles. musik-sammler.de gives a complete 40-track list in the same order, apart from typos. Count, order and titles therefore agree – MET.
tracklist.summary: MusicBrainz, Discogs, the back-cover reading and musik-sammler.de agree on 40 tracks in identical order, with only spelling or version-suffix variants.

sources.check: Level 5: a database plus an independent primary source of the same edition are required. Databases: MusicBrainz and Discogs – MET. Primary source: the back cover read by vision, showing barcode 731456031125 and cat. no. 560 311-2 – MET. The image is hosted on the MusicBrainz entry (CAA), but it is a reading of the actual print. musik-sammler.de is an additional collector source. All conditions met.
sources.summary: Two databases plus a read back-cover print with barcode and catalogue number of the same edition.
